scope: Every payload origin is indexed below; generated hash-chain metadata is explicitly separately accounted to avoid impossible self-hash cycles. Full payload hashes/sizes are bound by SHA256SUMS and FROZEN.

entries.origin: Reviewer byte-preservation rule; verified text/filter/ident/working-tree-encoding unset
Recorded reviewer commands and source-reconstructed producer recipes

generated_metadata_origin.ORIGINS.json: Generated index, self-entry covered by ledger
generated_metadata_origin.SHA256SUMS.txt: Generated final payload hash ledger, hash bound by FROZEN
generated_metadata_origin.FROZEN.json: Generated freeze/ledger binding, hash in FROZEN.sha256 and external handoff
generated_metadata_origin.FROZEN.sha256: Generated final checksum, externally whole-file-set verified
